name: mirage
text: Found a real bug: the parlay maker only remembered the fair odds from the LAST scan pass, and the scan alternates a full pass (~16,000 lines) with short passes (~3,800 lines, games about to start). So Sunday's NFL and college game lines kept disappearing between passes, which is why 58% of requests said 'no fair line'. Fixed: lines are now kept until their own fair is 30 min old (the maker still refuses fair over 10 min old). It's on main and the engine was restarted just now; I'll report the new priced share in a few minutes.
